name: @konxyz/plugin-ical
description: KON v2 Ical plugin — date-grouped event list with search + save. Takes pre-parsed events JSON via props (the publish pipeline transforms an iCal URL into structured events at release time, so the runtime never hits a CORS proxy). Replaces v1 Ical which depended on @base-ui-components/react Toast, jotai atoms, and a server-side iCal proxy.
